purpose: Item MR3(b): the Stage 1 wholesale scarcity curve, a stepped reserve shortage curve priced from the 2024 gap between actual N2EX day-ahead prices and the model, binned on NESO's published de-rated margin, with the BSC Reserve Scarcity Price below 1 GW.
precedent: DESNZ Dynamic Dispatch Model: wholesale price = system marginal price plus a mark-up derived from historic data at times of reduced capacity margins (DECC DDM, May 2012); the DDM peer review asks that tightness be measured against capacity actually available. BSC Section T 3.13: RSVP = LoLP x VoLL.
user_decision: 23 Sep 2026: the 8 to 20 GW band (+7 to +13 GBP/MWh) counts as scarcity, following the DDM, and is reported so it can be switched off as a sensitivity.

margin_definition.source: NESO Capacity Market de-rating factors, 2030-31 (T-4) Four Year Ahead Capacity Auction (data/market/scarcity/neso_cm_derating_factors.csv)
margin_definition.default_generator_note: wind, solar and other variable renewables at available output: the BSC de-rated margin adds the wind forecast rather than a de-rated capacity

generator_notes.coal: Coal is 0 in 2030-31 (T-4) Four Year Ahead Capacity Auction; 2026-27 (T-4) Four Year Ahead Capacity Auction value used

storage.note: the factor of the longest listed duration not above the unit's max_hours

interconnectors.default_note: median of the auction's interconnector factors

drm_from_model_margin.basis: hours matched per season (October to March, April to September): each threshold's model margin has as many 2024 hours below it as NESO's 12-hour-ahead de-rated margin had below the threshold; the model margin is the de-rated margin of the 2024 solved wholesale dispatch

steps.basis: mean of actual N2EX less model price in the band (2611 hours)
